scenarios.description: Rapid campaign: qualifying Flight 14 by September 23 local, represented by September 22.
Moderate delay: no qualifying launch by September 23, then launch September 24–30 local, represented by September 28.
Long delay: no qualifying launch by September 30, then launch during October, represented by October 7.
Severe interruption: no qualifying launch by October 31, represented by November campaign recovery; includes cancellation mass conservatively for this deadline.

limitations: Small independent paper forecast; subjective scenario weights and timings are not empirically calibrated.
Only exactly Flight 14 counts, after 2026-07-30T22:26:00Z and strictly before 2026-10-01T00:00:00-05:00 at Starbase. Trading close differs from event deadline and is not used.
No claim that planned launch, environmental review or static fire alone satisfies the contract.
No complete independent inventory of hardware readiness, final license, local closures or forecast weather was obtained.
SpaceX rendered pages returned no text and X returned 403; official mission content was retrieved directly from the public website content API.
Search snippets included qualitative community timing expectations; no numerical event probabilities or market prices were observed.
Model calls and costs are unmetered. Numeric zero counters in package records are unreported placeholders, not evidence of zero cost.
Scenario timestamps are representative points in a coarse discrete forecast distribution; omitted within-bin timing variation is a material limitation.
A reproducible computation and clean doctor result establish arithmetic and provenance integrity, not calibrated accuracy.
